name: Super Special Squad
description:
About This Game

SUPER SPECIAL SQUAD IS ON THE WAY

The world has been taken over by the "CyberBrunch" - a giant corporation run by AI.
Androids have gone insane and are turning against people. Synthetic drugs are making humans mutate. Toxic chemicals in cemetery soil are raising the dead.

Only one small resistance group is ready to fight back and save the planet from another apocalypse.

Mix and match your heroes, jump into action, and smash through hordes of enemies.
Gather resources, unlock new skills, level up your squad, and take down the "CyberBrunch" and its mad AI.

ASSEMBLE A TEAM OF HEROES

Each team member is unique. Every hero has their own special abilities and skills. Unlock new heroes, build your unique squad composition for specific tasks, use their abilities wisely, and earn victories even from the toughest battles.

GO ON A WORLD TOUR

Every journey is unique. Randomly generated adventures around the world await you. Enemies are everywhere - on sand dunes and in jungles, in permafrost and deep forests. Your squad's mission is to find and destroy "CyberBrunch", wherever it may be.

EXPLORE AND UPGRADE

A branching research tree will help enhance your chosen battle strategy. Level up firepower, speed, or survivability - the choice is yours.
short_desc: Super Special Squad is a team management tower defense game set in post apocalypse world. Build up your squad, earn money and gather resources, upgrade your heroes, destroy hundreds of enemies and save our planet Earth yet another time.
